terra.problem: The claim that offerings are all over the Bible is a fact outside this passage and has no reference.
The joke about listening being free makes the fathers' failure to listen the target of the joke.
The passage does not say whether the fathers requested a sign. Saying no sign was requested goes beyond the text.
Papa says he hid in the drawer, but his backstory says he was placed there. The comparison also suggests he was running from something.
The claim that the Bible has plenty of famines is a fact outside this passage and has no reference.
The fathers say God did what He purposed, but the passage does not state that He had said He would do those particular things.
“Purposed” and “refused” are not close in sound, so the comparison is inaccurate.
The image of a cookie sitting by the oven door deciding does not make a clear comparison to the answer.
